selection: Max mean AST/CED DEV pooled confirmation, subject to >=90% baseline confirmed claims retained in EACH cohort. No TEST metrics used.

inputs.reference_note: Audio votes frozen from v1, including its AST-silence guard and unsupervised library-wide knees. Names recomputed with current synonyms. TEST is held out for label decisions, not the historical audio screen.
inputs.split_policy: Preserve bench pack assignments; remaining normalized packs hash(seed=20261010) to 60% DEV, 40% TEST, without inspecting outcomes.

provenance_note: The backup lacks a tagger column. AST identity is supplied by the user; legacy-unspecified is preserved in output rows.
sparse_policy: <20 candidates, <5 confirmed or <2 confirming packs: retain uncalibrated flat candidates; no probability calibration claimed.
extension_note: v2 rules unchanged; new tags fitted with the v2 recipe on DEV packs only; TEST unused.
